ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the seating arrangement of the people of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'al-arā'ik' (couches/thrones) is interpreted not merely as furniture but as symbols of elevated spiritual status and intellectual clarity, reflecting the righteous who recline in ease while engaging in beneficial discourse. This imagery underscores the transition from the worldly struggle to a state of eternal peace where the believers face one another in mutual recognition and comfort, free from the distractions of the material world.
